final: WITH per_media AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_all FROM per_media), filtered AS (SELECT avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - avg_all AS diff FROM per_media CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_ratio > avg_all) SELECT AVG(avg_price), AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(diff) FROM filtered
